pathManage.heading: Manage Path goals

pathDelete.warning: Deleting this Path is permanent and can’t be undone. Everyone on this Path will lose access, and all goals, memberships, and recorded activity—including other participants’ recorded activity—will be permanently deleted.

pathLeave.heading: Leave “{{pathName}}”?
pathLeave.warning: You’ll immediately lose access to this Path. Your recorded activity will be retained, but hidden from everyone until you rejoin.
pathLeave.supporterWarning: You’ll immediately lose access to this Path.
pathLeave.choicePrompt: Choose what happens to your recorded activity on this Path.
pathLeave.keepActivityDescription: Your activity stays private while you’re away and returns if you rejoin.
pathLeave.deleteActivityDescription: Permanently delete only the activity you recorded on this Path.
pathLeave.deleteWarning: Only your recorded activity on this Path will be permanently deleted. It can’t be recovered and won’t return if you rejoin.

pathLeave.completedRetained: You left “{{pathName}}”. Your activity is retained and hidden until you rejoin.
